heroes.author: Michael Barera
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Michael Barera, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The exterior of the Adler Planetarium building on Chicago's lakefront.
heroes.why: Description confirms exterior; other exterior shots were either small public-domain postcards (about 820 px) or lacked a clear description.

heroes.author: Joe Ross, Lansing, Michigan
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Joe Ross, Lansing, Michigan, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The main exhibit area of the Armstrong Air and Space Museum with the Gemini VIII capsule and the Aeronca Champion flown by Neil Armstrong.
heroes.why: Only landscape shot among the set (the rest are portrait) and it shows the key space exhibit; no exterior photo with a clear licence found.

heroes.author: Vladi stoichkov
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Vladi stoichkov, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: An Ilyushin Il-2 attack aircraft on display at Krumovo.
heroes.why: Weak: Commons has almost nothing for this museum; this is a single exhibit (description only says Ilyushin Il-2, location Krumovo), not the building. Review before use.

heroes.author: Ninara (Helsinki, Finland)
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Ninara (Helsinki, Finland), CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: A Soyuz spacecraft on display at the Baikonur Cosmodrome Space Museum.
heroes.why: Description names the museum and its Soyuz exhibit; other CC BY options were crew-with-people shots or lower-res.

heroes.author: King of Hearts
heroes.credit_line: Photo: King of Hearts, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The California Science Center building in Los Angeles.
heroes.why: Large landscape exterior with a description naming the building.

heroes.author: Bubba73 (Jud McCranie)
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Bubba73 (Jud McCranie), CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Launch Complex 26 blockhouse at Cape Canaveral, the main building of the Air Force Space and Missile Museum (now the Space Force Museum).
heroes.why: Only exterior of the museum's own building at 1600 px or wider with a clear licence; a sibling file (LC26Block.jpg) states LC-26 blockhouse is the museum's home.

heroes.author: N509FZ
heroes.credit_line: Photo: N509FZ, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The China Science and Technology Museum building in Beijing.
heroes.why: Newest high-resolution view of the main building; I judged by file title only, the description is just 'Best angle?'. Visually unchecked.

heroes.author: Patrick Pelletier
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Patrick Pelletier, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The front of the Kansas Cosmosphere building in Hutchinson.
heroes.why: Description explicitly says front of the building; the larger 2014 Ichabod file has no stated subject.

heroes.author: Mike Peel
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Mike Peel, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The entrance of the Cradle of Aviation Museum.
heroes.why: High-resolution entrance shot; the public-domain exterior is only 914 px.

heroes.author: Leif Jorgensen
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Leif Jorgensen, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: A part of Danmarks Tekniske Museum in Helsingor.
heroes.why: Weak: description only says 'a part of' the museum; I could not see the image so it may be an exhibit rather than the building. Review before use.

heroes.author: Orderinchaos
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Orderinchaos, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Esperance Museum building with the Skylab monument outside.
heroes.why: Shows both the building and its Skylab debris display.

heroes.author: Web.fernbank
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Web.fernbank, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: Inside the planetarium at Fernbank Science Center.
heroes.why: Weak: every exterior photo on Commons is 1024 px or smaller; this is the only 1200+ px image and it is an interior, content not visually checked.

heroes.author: Michael Barera
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Michael Barera, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Franklin Institute building in Philadelphia.
heroes.why: Large landscape photo of the building, description names it.

heroes.author: Aaron Manning
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Aaron Manning, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The INFINITY Science Center in Pearlington, Mississippi.
heroes.why: Only a file title and a one-line description to go on; I did not view the image. The CC BY-SA entranceway shots may show the access road rather than the building.

heroes.author: Acroterion
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Acroterion, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Intrepid Sea, Air and Space Museum ship against the west side Manhattan skyline, seen from the Hudson River.
heroes.why: High-resolution landscape of the whole museum; description names it. Shows the ship, not the Space Shuttle pavilion.

heroes.author: Kestrel
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Kestrel, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The entrance of the Sagamihara Campus of JAXA's Institute of Space and Astronautical Science.
heroes.why: Weak: shows the campus entrance, not the exhibition hall itself; no Commons photo of the hall was found.

heroes.author: Michael Rivera
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Michael Rivera, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The Rocket Garden at Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex.
heroes.why: Large landscape of the Visitor Complex's signature outdoor exhibit; not visually checked.

heroes.author: Texnik
heroes.credit_line: Photo: Texnik, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons
heroes.shows: The S. P. Korolev Museum of Cosmonautics in Zhytomyr.
heroes.why: Description names the museum; I did not view the image. A 3072 px sibling by Sergiy Remez (Житомир. Музей космонавтики.jpg) is an alternative.
Commons searches (name, Waco, category) returned nothing relevant; no openly licensed photo found.
